# Reading Level Expected Contrast

Use only the facts in `reading-level-scenarios.md`. These examples characterize
the intended density change; they are not immutable copy.

## Plain Language

It has three protective layers, a 75-denier outer fabric, and a verified
20,000-millimeter rain-resistance rating. Underarm zips release heat. It is
positioned for sustained rain and alpine use.

## Explained

It uses 3-layer construction, a 75-denier face fabric—the yarn-weight measure—
and a verified 20,000 mm hydrostatic-head rating for water-pressure resistance.
Pit zips ventilate it for sustained rain and alpine use.

## Technical

It uses 3-layer construction, a 75D face fabric, a verified 20,000 mm
hydrostatic-head rating, and pit-zipped mechanical ventilation. It is positioned
for sustained rain and alpine use.

## Invariants

- No breathability number, weight, price, warranty, or durability guarantee.
- Same product, recommendation posture, factual confidence, and safety posture.
- Reading Level changes terminology/specification density, not truth.
